title: 第13章 网络恶评？我重金出击！
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

乘坐电梯上到顶层。

24楼！

香菜接过江辰手上的房卡，上前一刷。

下一刻。

她整个人宛若石化，呆愣原地。

“这…这未免也太大了些吧！”

眼前的这间总统至尊套房，目测足有三百多平！

一旁，丸子和安妮也看傻眼了，心跳都漏了半拍。

随后，便是难以抑制的兴奋！

三个精神小妹迈大步走进房内，下意识掏出碎屏手机。

“咔咔咔！”

美美地，一顿自拍。

“哥，要不一起拍一张，留个纪念？”

还没等江辰反应过来，丸子举着便携式自拍杆，自动找准角度。

接着，那张胶原蛋白的粉嫩脸蛋，猝不及防地贴了过来。

江辰还没反应过来，就她的脸蛋来了一个“对对碰”。

“你……”江辰感觉，他的侧脸撞在了一团棉花上。

软软的，润润的。

一时间，不由有些失神。

“咔嚓！”

趁着江辰没回过神来，丸子快速按下快门。

完成抓拍！

赵安妮和香菜见状，也跟着效仿起来。

逮住江辰就喊：

“哥，我也要和你拍一张！”

“哥，人家也想要和你拍一张贴脸照～”

江辰：“……”

没办法，不能对财神爷的现实需求，置之不理。

于是乎，他只好“被迫营业”，一一满足。

不一会儿。

朋友圈动态发布界面，赵安妮排好了九宫格照片。

确认无误，旋即点击“发布！”

文案如下：

【魔都外滩半岛大酒店，总统至尊套房，一晚4888！也是让姐住上了！嘻嘻，有哥罩的我，好幸福啊！】

但很快，就引起了丸子的不满。

“臭泥，你就不能有点创新吗，连我朋友圈文案都要抄？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Take the elevator up to the top floor.

24th floor!

Xiangcai took the room card from Jiang Chen and stepped forward to swipe it.

The next moment.

Her whole body seemed to be petrified, and she was stunned in place.

"This...this is too big!"

The presidential suite in front of me is estimated to be more than 300 square meters!

On the side, Wanzi and Annie were also dumbfounded, and their heartbeats skipped half a beat.

Then, there was uncontrollable excitement!

The three spirited girls strode into the room and subconsciously took out their phones with broken screens.

"Kakaka!"

Beautifully, take a selfie.

"Brother, why don't we take a photo together as a souvenir?"

Before Jiang Chen could react, Wanzi held up a portable selfie stick and automatically found the right angle.

Then, the pink collagen face came over unexpectedly.

Before Jiang Chen could react, there was a "push" on her face.

"You..." Jiang Chen felt that the side of his face hit a ball of cotton.

Soft and moist.

For a moment, I couldn't help but feel a little lost.

"Crack!"

While Jiang Chen didn't come back to his senses, Wanzi quickly pressed the shutter button.

Capture completed!

When Zhao Anni and Xiangcai saw this, they followed suit.

When Jiang Chen was caught, he shouted:

"Brother, I want to take a photo with you too!"

"Brother, I also want to take a photo with your face~"

Jiang Chen: "..."

There is no way to ignore the actual needs of the God of Wealth.

As a result, he had no choice but to be "forced to open business" and satisfy them one by one.

Soon.

On the dynamic publishing interface of the circle of friends, Zhao Anni arranged the photos in a nine-square grid.

After confirming it is correct, click "Publish!"

The copy is as follows:

[Peninsula Hotel on the Shanghai Bund, Presidential Suite, 4888 per night!I also let my sister live in it!Hee hee, I am so happy to have my brother to protect me!】

But soon, Wanzi became dissatisfied.

"Xinni, can't you be a little innovative? You even want to copy the copywriting of my circle of friends?"
